exclude_selectors drops entire subtree unlike strip_tags which keeps children

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = '<body><div class="wrapper"><p>Inner paragraph</p></div><p>Outer text</p></body>'
    options = ConversionOptions(exclude_selectors=[".wrapper"])
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result)

main()
```
